head: InviteJam: free online invitations with RSVP tracking
dek: InviteJam is a new website for making digital invitations from more than 300 designs and tracking who's coming. Guests reply through a link without an app or an account.
details: You can also upload your own design. You can add questions for meal choices, dietary needs and plus-ones, and a dashboard shows a live count of yes, no and maybe replies plus who hasn't answered. Editing an invitation updates it at the same link. The free plan covers up to 3 events with 15 guests each and shows a small InviteJam banner; an event pass or a Pro plan removes it, raises the guest limit and adds reminders, but the site's main page doesn't list their prices.
where: Web, out now; free plan available
means: If you're planning a birthday or a wedding, this keeps invites and replies in one place, and guests don't have to sign up for anything. Bigger guest lists need a paid plan.
todo: Try the free plan for a small party first and check the paid prices on the site before a big event.
